title: promote-latest step 1 accepts a failed Release run only under DEC-204 (a4)'s Windows-probe excuse
description: opum-doc ruling DEC-204 (a4), 2026-10-20T09:05Z, relayed by team-lead under DEC-182. scripts/promote-latest.mjs step 1 (checkReleaseRun) refuses any Release run that did not conclude success, so run 39366418979 (v0.14.1 dry run, the run the pair receipt names and whose artifact was staged) can never be promoted: its two Windows release-gate-probe arms fail at setup-quest, which refuses a source build on Windows while quest 0.14.1 is not on npm (ETARGET), and the probe never runs there. Change: a run that concluded failure is accepted ONLY when ALL FOUR hold: (1) every failed job is a Windows release-gate-probe arm; (2) each such arm log shows the setup-quest Windows refusal and no other ##[error] line; (3) @opum-ai/quest@<version> was not installable from npm at the run start, measured from npm own time[<version>] against the run created_at, never against now, an absent publish time counting as not installable; (4) every other job concluded success. Anything else refuses as today and the refusal names the failed condition. When it applies one line names the excused jobs and DEC-204 (a4). Proof through the injectable runner with no network: accepted on 39366418979 shape; refused by name for a non-Windows failure, a Windows probe failing another way, a Windows probe with an extra ##[error], and quest already installable at run start; a mutation disabling the check reddens the refusal tests, its prediction committed first. Scoped to promote-latest.mjs; the same excuse lands in publish-release.sh under LCLI-742 for the next pair, and the real fix (setup-quest on Windows) belongs in the next pair plan and retires this excuse.

acceptanceCriteria.text: promote-latest step 1 accepts a failed run only when all four DEC-204 (a4) conditions hold, and every other failed run refuses naming the condition
tests prove it both ways through the injectable runner with no network: the 39366418979 shape accepts; each of four named shapes refuses
a mutation that disables the check turns the refusal tests red, with its prediction committed before it was run
one Opum review recorded, then landed on the leader word
the dry run is re-run against 39366418979 with --dry-run only and its output reported

implementationNotes: MUTATION PREDICTIONS, committed BEFORE any mutant is run (code at 8260023e: 231 pass, 0 fail in test/promote-latest.test.ts). Refusal cases in refusalSuite: 11, each run in --dry-run and --promote. M1 = disable the whole check by removing the final `if (failed.length) return refuse();` in evaluateWindowsProbeExcuse. PREDICT 18 red: the 9 cases that reach the end (non-Windows probe failed; a non-probe job failed; Windows arm cancelled; Windows probe failing another way; refusal only in step SOURCE; refusal plus extra ##[error]; quest already installable; quest publish times unreadable; run with no failed job) x 2 modes. PREDICT 4 stay GREEN: jobs unreadable and jobs cut off, because they return before the mutated line. The accepted-shape tests, the cancelled-run test, the other-commit test and the successful-run test stay green. M2 = drop condition 3 by removing the `else if (publishedAt <= startedAt)` branch. PREDICT exactly 2 red: the quest-already-installable case in both modes. M3 = drop the other-##[error] check by making `strangers` always empty. PREDICT exactly 2 red: the extra-##[error] case in both modes.
